Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `this_ptr_00` self-updates via the address of a constant index into itself plus a subfield path, where `N*sizeof(*this_ptr_00) + offsetof(subfield)` equals the real array stride. Replace `this_ptr_00->some_field[0]` (or the zero-index access) reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.
Ghidra mistranslated a Watcom float bit-pattern compare as `(int)x`. Hex 0x3f800000 is the IEEE 754 bit pattern of 1f. Rewrite in a .keep as a plain float compare against 1f.
